stemMd: Solve sin x = 0 on 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π. How many solutions are there?
explanationMd: Sine vanishes at integer multiples of π. In the stated closed interval these are 0, π and 2π. Both endpoints are included, giving three solutions.

distractorRationale.b: This counts only the first endpoint.
distractorRationale.c: This omits one endpoint even though both are included.
distractorRationale.e: There are only three multiples of π in the closed interval.
distractorRationale.a: Sine is zero at multiples of π.
